description: Decrypt an "S3E1.…" message made by the S3eidat Text Encrypt website or crypto_text_encrypt, with its password. Verifies integrity: a wrong password or any change to the text is reported, never garbage output. Accepts base64url and line breaks. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/text-encrypt/

encrypted.description: The encrypted text, starting with S3E1.

output.description: Optional: also save the decrypted message to this file.

password.description: The password. Normalised to Unicode NFC first, like the website.

path.description: Or: a file containing it (e.g. encrypted.txt).

name: crypto_text_decrypt
title: Decrypt text (AES-256-GCM)
